description: Full name of the individual participant (string).
Conference abbreviation (e.g., MZT, SLU).
Year of the conference (integer).
Number of sessions in this conference-year where the person acted as a facilitator (integer).
Number of sessions in this conference-year where the person was assigned as a team member (integer).
Number of sessions in this conference-year where the person spoke but was not a facilitator or team member (integer).
Number of sessions where the person appeared but did not fit facilitator/member/participant (integer).
Total number of sessions attended by the person in this conference-year (integer).
Primary role classification for the year (facilitator > member > participant > unknown).
Average speaking duration (in seconds) per session for the person (float).
Average number of speaking turns per session for the person (float).
Average number of smiles made by the speaker themselves per session (float).
Average number of smiles from others while the person was speaking per session (float).
Average number of nods from others during the person's speaking turns per session (float).
Average number of interruptions made by the person per session (float).
Average number of segments where the person shared their screen per session (float).
Number of funded teams this person belonged to during the conference-year (integer).
Number of unfunded teams this person belonged to during the conference-year (integer).
Comma-separated list of team IDs the person belonged to in this conference-year (string).
Total number of teams the person belonged to in this conference-year (integer).
Average number of overlapping speech events made by the person per session (float).
Binary flag (1 if facilitator, else 0).
Binary flag (1 if non-facilitator, else 0).
Binary flag (1 if the person is on at least one team in this conference-year, else 0).
Binary flag (1 if the person is in at least one funded team in this conference-year, else 0).
Binary flag (1 if the person’s primary role is member, else 0).
Binary flag (1 if the person’s primary role is participant, else 0).
